tasks.label: Setup: update and upgrade Homebrew, npm
tasks.command: brew update && brew upgrade --yes && npm update -g

tasks.label: Setup: full sync this project to host
tasks.detail: Run the full local-setup sequence for a host: update package managers, publish local skills, link scripts/IDE and Claude files, refresh and install remote skills, sync OpenCode + VSCode configs, install the daily update LaunchAgent, and install pre-commit. Skips 'Sync: Claude settings globally' (it replaces the file wholesale). Prompts once for skill scope and once for sync-confirm — type 'yes' at the sync prompt or the two Sync tasks stay dry-run. Stops if any step exits non-zero (most likely 'Setup: link scripts and IDE' when no editor bundle is found).
dependsOn: Setup: update and upgrade Homebrew, npm
Setup: link scripts and IDE to ~/.local/bin
Link: Claude Code to project files
Sync: VSCode settings and tasks to Devin User

tasks.label: Skills: install local (development-best-practices)
tasks.detail: Publish this repo's development-best-practices skill globally (copies to ~/.agents/skills/, symlinks to ~/.claude/skills/). Cross-project by nature: git branch and worktree hygiene, day-to-day dev workflow conventions.
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add ./.agents/skills/development-best-practices --agent claude-code --agent opencode --agent codex --global --yes

tasks.label: Skills: install local (python-styleguide)
tasks.detail: Publish this repo's python-styleguide skill globally (copies to ~/.agents/skills/, symlinks to ~/.claude/skills/). Cross-project by nature: shared Python style rules for all internal projects.
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add ./.agents/skills/python-styleguide --agent claude-code --agent opencode --agent codex --global --yes

tasks.label: Skills: install local (all)
tasks.detail: Publish every locally-authored skill worth having in all projects (runs each install task in sequence). Always --global by design: these skills already live in .agents/skills/, so a project-scope install would copy them onto themselves and the duplicate would silently drift. Keep this list minimal — OpenCode reads ~/.agents/skills/ directly, so every skill here costs context in every session of every project.

tasks.label: Setup: link scripts and IDE to ~/.local/bin
tasks.detail: Bootstrap a fresh clone: symlink this repo's cross-project scripts, plus an `ide` editor launcher, into ~/.local/bin so every task that calls them by bare name resolves. Run this first on a new host — the other tasks assume it has run. Invoked by explicit path because it is what puts the bare names on PATH. Idempotent; refuses to overwrite anything that is not already a symlink. Warns instead of failing if no editor bundle is found.

tasks.label: Setup: add .env to global gitignore
tasks.detail: Append '.env' to the machine-wide git ignore file so no repo can stage a .env, without touching any repo's tracked .gitignore. Writes to core.excludesFile when that is configured, else git's XDG default (~/.config/git/ignore), creating it if missing — writing to the wrong one would silently do nothing. Idempotent; prints the resulting file. Per-repo one-offs belong in that repo's .git/info/exclude instead.
tasks.command: f=$(git config --global core.excludesFile || echo "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/git/ignore"); f=${f/#\~/$HOME}; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$f")"; grep -qxF '.env' "$f" 2>/dev/null || printf '.env\n' >> "$f"; echo "--- $f ---"; cat "$f"

tasks.label: Link: .claude/skills to .agents/skills
tasks.detail: Symlink the whole .claude/skills directory to .agents/skills, so Claude Code sees every project skill (it only scans .claude/skills/; OpenCode reads .agents/skills/ directly). Linking the directory rather than each skill means new skills need no re-run. Refuses if .agents/skills is missing (the link would dangle), or if .claude/skills holds a real entry absent from .agents/skills, which would be lost.

tasks.label: Link: CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md
tasks.detail: Replace CLAUDE.md with a symlink to AGENTS.md so both Claude Code and other agents read one instruction file. Refuses to clobber a CLAUDE.md that holds its own content — delete it manually first if that is intended.

tasks.label: Link: Claude Code to project files
tasks.detail: Point Claude Code at this project's shared agent files: CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md and .claude/skills -> .agents/skills (runs both link tasks in sequence). Safe to re-run; both tasks are idempotent.

tasks.label: Skills: install remote (logfire)
tasks.detail: Install the upstream logfire skills from pydantic/skills for Claude Code and OpenCode. Skills are named explicitly because the repo also ships unrelated skills. Prompts for install scope (default: this project). Tracked in a skills lock file, so 'Skills: update from remote sources' refreshes them.
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add pydantic/skills --skill logfire-instrumentation --skill logfire-query --skill logfire-ui --agent claude-code --agent opencode ${input:skillScope} --yes

tasks.label: Skills: install remote (supabase)
tasks.detail: Install the upstream supabase skills from supabase/agent-skills for Claude Code and OpenCode. Prompts for install scope (default: this project). Tracked in a skills lock file, so 'Skills: update from remote sources' refreshes them.
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add supabase/agent-skills --skill supabase --skill supabase-postgres-best-practices --agent claude-code --agent opencode ${input:skillScope} --yes

tasks.label: Skills: install remote (skill-creator)
tasks.detail: Install Anthropic's skill-creator from anthropics/skills for Claude Code and OpenCode. Used instead of superpowers' writing-skills for authoring and evaluating skills. Prompts for install scope (default: this project).
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add anthropics/skills --skill skill-creator --agent claude-code --agent opencode ${input:skillScope} --yes

tasks.label: Skills: install remote (superpowers subset)
tasks.detail: Install the three superpowers skills worth keeping (brainstorming, systematic-debugging, writing-plans) from obra/superpowers, without the plugin's always-on SessionStart context injection. Prompts for install scope (default: this project).
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add obra/superpowers --skill brainstorming --skill systematic-debugging --skill writing-plans --skill test-driven-development --skill subagent-driven-development --skill requesting-code-review --agent claude-code --agent opencode ${input:skillScope} --yes

tasks.label: Skills: install remote (langfuse)
tasks.detail: Install the langfuse skill from langfuse/skills for Claude Code and OpenCode. Prompts for install scope (default: this project).
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add langfuse/skills --skill langfuse --agent opencode --agent claude-code ${input:skillScope} --yes

tasks.label: Langfuse: generate auth header
tasks.detail: Base64 Basic-auth header from LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY / LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY, for the LANGFUSE_AUTH_HEADER var consumed by the Langfuse docs MCP server in .mcp.json. https://langfuse.com/docs/api-and-data-platform/features/mcp-server#set-up

tasks.label: Skills: install remote (all)
tasks.detail: Install every remote-sourced skill (runs all install tasks in sequence). Each prompts for scope. On-demand: these are not installed by default to keep agent context small.

tasks.label: Skills: update from remote sources
tasks.detail: Re-fetch all skills tracked in ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json from their remote sources and re-copy if changed

tasks.label: Sync: OpenCode config globally
tasks.detail: Copy this project's OpenCode, TUI and opencode-notifier configs plus the .mcp.json loader and schema to ~/.config/opencode. Shows a diff unless you type 'yes'. opencode-notifier.json has no project-scoped lookup at all — the plugin hardcodes ~/.config/opencode/opencode-notifier.json (only OPENCODE_NOTIFIER_CONFIG_PATH overrides it), so this task is the only thing that makes the repo copy take effect.

tasks.label: Sync: Claude settings globally
tasks.detail: Copy this project's Claude Code settings to ~/.claude/settings.json. Shows a diff unless you type 'yes'. Note this replaces the file wholesale — any global-only keys (e.g. a permissions.allow list) are dropped, so read the diff before confirming.

tasks.label: Sync: VSCode settings and tasks to Devin User
tasks.detail: Overwrite Devin User settings.json and tasks.json with workspace .vscode config. Shows a diff unless you type 'yes'.

tasks.label: OpenCode: list running processes
tasks.detail: Print the PID and working directory of each running OpenCode process

tasks.label: System: caffeinate process
tasks.detail: Prevent idle system sleep until the process with the provided PID exits

tasks.label: Setup: install daily brew/npm update (launchd)
tasks.detail: Install a user LaunchAgent that runs 'brew update && brew upgrade --yes && npm update -g' daily at midnight. Uses launchd, not cron: a job missed while the Mac is asleep runs at next wake instead of being silently dropped. Does not wake the Mac. Idempotent; logs to ~/Library/Logs/brew-npm-update.log. Portable across hosts.

tasks.label: Setup: uninstall daily brew/npm update (launchd)
tasks.detail: Unload and remove the daily brew/npm update LaunchAgent installed by 'Setup: install daily brew/npm update (launchd)'.

tasks.label: OKF: regenerate index
tasks.detail: Regenerate index.md for the selected OKF bundle from concept frontmatter

tasks.label: OKF: install skill
tasks.detail: Install only the selected okf-* skill globally via npx skills (copies to ~/.agents/skills/, symlinks to ~/.claude/skills/)
tasks.command: npx --yes skills add ./.agents/skills/okf-${input:okfBundle} --agent claude-code --agent opencode --agent codex --global --yes

tasks.label: OKF: build site
tasks.detail: Regenerate okf-site.html for the selected OKF bundle

tasks.label: OKF: open site
tasks.detail: Open the generated OKF site for the selected bundle in the browser

tasks.label: OKF: build & open site
tasks.detail: Build and then open the selected OKF bundle's site

tasks.label: OKF: regenerate index, install skill, build and open site
tasks.detail: Regenerate the index, install the skill, build and open the site for the selected bundle (runs all three in sequence)

tasks.label: Git: create worktree and open in IDE
Python: list venv packages by size
tasks.detail: List this project's installed packages by size. Runs under `uv run` so it inspects the current project's venv; the script is found on PATH.

tasks.label: Pre-commit: run
tasks.command: uv run pre-commit run --all-files || uv run pre-commit run --all-files

tasks.label: AWS: login to ECR docker registry
tasks.command: aws --profile ${AWS_PROFILE} ecr get-login-password --region ${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION} | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin ${DOCKER_REPO}

tasks.label: Bir: Vault login via LDAP
tasks.detail: Authenticates the vault CLI against vault.kapitalbank.az via LDAP and stores the token in ~/.vault-token (valid ~24h). Prompts for username and then password interactively.

tasks.label: Bir: Vault login via approle, copy token and open apollo secrets
tasks.detail: AppRole-login to the Vault at VAULT_ADDR with VAULT_ROLE_ID / VAULT_SECRET_ID, copy the returned token to the clipboard (never printed), then open that same Vault's apollo KV list in the browser. Chained with && so a failed login neither clobbers the clipboard nor opens the page.
tasks.command: token=$(vault write -field=token auth/approle/login role_id="$VAULT_ROLE_ID" secret_id="$VAULT_SECRET_ID") && printf %s "$token" | pbcopy && echo "Vault token from $VAULT_ADDR copied to clipboard" && open "${VAULT_ADDR%/}/ui/vault/secrets/secret/kv/list/apollo/"

inputs.description: Branch name for the new worktree
Optional worktree directory (absolute, or relative to <main>/.worktrees/ when run from the main worktree, else to the current worktree's parent; defaults to normalized branch name)
Which OKF bundle to act on (skill dir is .agents/skills/okf-<value>/, bundle dir is <value>/ inside it)
Type 'yes' to overwrite the destination files; anything else only prints the diff
PID of the process to caffeinate
Number of days to look back
